integrity.claim_scope: Complete classification of ordinary paired-dominating vertex sets in generalized windmills.
integrity.computation_role: Finite exhaustive checks corroborate but do not replace the general proof.

scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected generalized windmills only, with k>=2 and m>=2.
The scalar paired-domination number is prior work; the retained contribution is the complete all-set classification and polynomial.
The 2023 journal article was not open in full; the corresponding 2023 dissertation was inspected in full at the relevant windmill section.
title: Paired-domination polynomial of generalized windmill graphs
